name: obsidian-mdx-editor
description: A visual and source editor for MDX files in Obsidian.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && bun build src/main.tsx src/styles.css --outdir . --target browser --format cjs --external obsidian --minify
scripts.dev: bun build src/main.tsx src/styles.css --outdir . --target browser --format cjs --external obsidian --watch

author: Arjun Kumar
